title: Accepted-frame scientific and presentation output
summary: Streams accepted finite-element frames through existing XDMF and optional VTK backends, records field semantics, and checks declared output dependencies.

science.statement: Output consumes committed solver states; field recovery and display conversion do not alter the governing equations or supply convergence evidence.

equations.label: accepted coordinate order
equations.description: s denotes physical time, load factor or another explicitly named segment coordinate.

inputs.name: accepted fields
inputs.description: Lagrange primary field and compatible auxiliary fields on one fixed mesh.

outputs.name: field and presentation artifacts
outputs.description: Not a substitute for raw material state or restart checkpoints.

assumptions: Fixed mesh and field schema within a segment.
conventions: MPI primary interpolation to geometry degree is recorded.
applicability: Standard static/history exporters and custom finite-element loops.
limitations: No arbitrary remeshing within a segment.
No recovery guarantee for crashed collective MPI I/O.
Dependency checks are not physical validation.

usage.minimal_example:
with results.output_series(result, 'fields.xdmf', paraview=True) as series:
    series.write_accepted(coordinate=1., primary=u, fields=(stress,))

validation_rules: Read every saved frame and compare preserved values.
Preserve field data when optional presentation fails.
